dedupe_keys.name: infrastructure climate risk data starter kit for namibia

description: Oxford infrastructure-resilience researchers publish preliminary road and rail risk estimates for Namibia. Zenodo supplies GeoPackages, administrative boundaries, a QGIS project and a README free under CC BY 4.0. Layers describe road or rail damages for river and coastal flooding and landslides, using OpenStreetMap network extracts and global hazard inputs. OpenGIRA produced the risk calculations. These results can benchmark hazard exposure and damage calculations in transport-resilience simulations. Related catalogue data-infrastructure-climate-resilience-data-starter-kits supplies the source exposure layers; catalogue model-open-gira and platform-gri-infrastructure-risk-visualisation-tool represent the workflow and viewer. This deposit contains derived damages, not another copy of the Namibia input kit. The provider calls it preliminary and pending review as of August 2025. A limitation is that global inputs and assumed vulnerability functions constrain local accuracy. No GeoPackage was downloaded or damage estimates independently verified.
name: Infrastructure Climate Risk Data Starter Kit for Namibia
